Capture A, 2026-11-16 UTC. One fresh 30-day scratch org on a campaign Dev Hub with the standard Account, Contact and Lead duplicate rules active and three custom rules: N3Co (Account Name, CompanyName method), N3Title (Contact Title, Title method, with an exact LastName item) and N3LeadCo (Lead Company, CompanyName method). The org was deleted and its active record verified gone. Group observations (t1ln1_p1 surnames, t1fn1_p1 first names and t1em1_p1 surnames with similar first names on the standard Contact rule beside one email address; t2c_p1 and t2l_p1 the phone section grid on the standard Contact and Lead rules; t3ti1_p1 and t3ts1_p1 titles on N3Title; t4co1_p1 company names on N3Co) and group canary (a control panel run between the others) cover Apex API 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and @IsTest, two repeats; every observation of a panel agrees across API, route and repeat. Lines 1 to 89 of org.tsv are that capture file unchanged, sha256 54c8f92a2e07b93400627a96676f672756faf4719b6337c9d2f3dcdba7a8f01f. Ids, usernames and hosts do not occur in the rows. Names are synthetic.
Capture B, 2026-11-16 UTC. A second fresh scratch org with the custom Contact rule N1First (FirstName, FirstName method, with LastName); deleted and verified gone. Group first_name, f1t_p1: the first names of t1fn1_p1 with one last name, eight observation files assembled into rows; all agree.
Captures C, D and E, 2026-11-16 UTC. Three fresh 30-day scratch orgs, one per capture, with the rules of capture A; each org was deleted and its active record verified gone (1 to 0, the local target no longer resolves). Group boundaries. Capture C: r2ln_p1 (surnames one letter apart or of one length, one first name, one email address), r2pc_p1 and r2pl_p1 (phone line differences with and without email addresses and the country digit), r2ti_p1 (single-letter titles of one to five letters) and r2co_p1 (spaced slash against parenthesis forms on bases of 10 to 14 letters); export sha256 da80b8ee9a5adc231c9b930dd65809619348fd72b809af6bec093ab2bc534e77. Capture D: r3ln_p1 (more surnames one letter apart), r3pc_p1 and r3pl_p1 (phone line differences under five first and last names); export sha256 f3764b5aebef679b0ee8f0bc0ec28fa17d0d231ff73ca467fa164779bbf36840. Capture E: r4pc_p1 (phone line differences under 15 first and last names); export sha256 a94dddc93b4f9a80d7515e1f2fd7b6331dfd59996f9fc655d1e29337999d38c8. Each panel covers Apex API 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and @IsTest, two repeats; all eight observations of every panel agree and every control panel matched. The rows are the exported observation rows with the group renamed; the control rows are left out.
Observation encoding: the number of values, then one token per match: candidate index and existing index in base 36, and the confidence when it is not 100. A value holds its fields separated by "|" in the order of the field list; an empty part leaves the field blank.
